Every unit from MYP1 to MYP5 is a small version of the ePortfolio: Task 1 is Criterion A, Task 2 is B, Task 3 is C and Task 4 is
D. Each unit keeps the skills from earlier units and adds **one new skill** in each strand it assesses. Pick your unit to see
what is new, what you should already be doing, and where it goes next. Tick the skills you can do; your ticks stay in this
browser. Click any heading to fold its section.

## The rubric climbs

The MYP uses three rubrics: Year 1 in MYP1, Year 3 in MYP2–3 and Year 5 in MYP4–5. Keep doing what earned top marks last stage
and you drop two marks. The verbs link to the [glossary](glossary.qmd#command-term-ladders).

::: {.crs}
<div id="pw-rubric"></div>
:::

## The whole sequence

The one new skill each unit adds, strand by strand. A dash means the strand is not assessed in that unit.

## Beyond the rubric

The rubric is the part everyone shares. Each of you also chooses your own [enrichment](enrichment.qmd) to grow as a musician
in the directions you care about.
